summary.en: Attack the general; trap it to win.
summary.zh: 攻击老将，困死它就赢了。

text.en: When a piece attacks the general, that's check (将军). The other side must answer it at once: move the general, block, or capture the attacker.
text.zh: 攻击对方的将（帅）叫“将军”。对方必须马上应将：走开老将、垫子挡住，或吃掉将军的棋子。

text.en: Checkmate means check with no way out. Find a move that checkmates Black.
text.zh: 将死就是被将军后无法应将。找一步把黑方将死。

hint.en: Your horse already guards e8. Use a chariot to check.
hint.zh: 你的马已经控制了e8。用车来将军。

wrong.en: Black can still escape. Try another check.
wrong.zh: 黑将还能逃走。换一步将军试试。

success.en: Checkmate! Black's general has nowhere to go.

text.en: Two chariots against a lone general. Checkmate Black in at most 4 moves — Black will defend.
text.zh: 双车对单将。最多走4步将死黑方——黑方会防守。

hint.en: Use one chariot to cut off a rank, then check with the other on the next rank.
hint.zh: 一个车封住一条横线，另一个车在旁边那条横线将军。

success.en: Well done! This two-chariot mate (双车错) is a pattern worth remembering.
success.zh: 很好！这个双车错杀法值得牢记。

text.en: A player has no legal move but is not in check. What happens?
text.zh: 一方无棋可走，但没有被将军，结果是什么？

explanation.en: In Xiangqi, having no legal move always loses (困毙), unlike chess where stalemate is a draw.
explanation.zh: 象棋中无子可动就输（困毙），这和国际象棋的逼和不同。
